Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1167
Claimant:
Terri Miller
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
10-23-23
Insured driver reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. Claimant is listed as a passenger and
is now represented by counsel, who has submitted a bodily injury demand alleging a wrist fracture.
11-11-23
Reviewed the police report and the photos taken at the scene. The vehicle damage is consistent with the described
impact, and a few older scratches on the panel may predate this loss.
11-27-23
The responding officer and two independent drivers who stopped at the scene both state that the claimant was not
inside the vehicle when the collision occurred. Statements have been requested to clarify this point.
12-5-23
Confirmed the insured is named on the policy and found nothing indicating the damage happened before coverage
began. Coverage position remains under review pending the bodily injury evaluation.
1-17-24
Claimant's account of the collision has been consistent in every contact so far, including the initial call and the
recorded statement. Counsel has provided the medical records for the wrist.
1-25-24
The medical records show a fracture diagnosis, but the impact described appears very light for injury of this severity.
Requested the imaging and any prior records for the wrist and surrounding area.
2-9-24
Prior records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully with no lasting limitation.
Treatment after this loss followed a typical course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
2-22-24
No independent eyewitnesses have come forward, and the scene photos confirm some of the reported details without
settling the question of how the injury occurred. Referred the file for a medical records review.
3-25-24
Sent the reviewer's summary to counsel requesting a response to the outstanding questions about the claimant's
location at impact and the prior history. File remains open pending that response.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
